title: Backup push docs say a failed push leaves the previous receipt as it was, but resolving a pending attempt can first record a new newest receipt
outcome: Backup push docs say a failed push leaves the previous receipt as it was, but resolving a pending attempt can first record a new newest receipt
acceptance: docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md's push paragraph and docs/shipped.md's Backup push row no longer say that every failed push leaves the previous receipt as it was and advances no time. They say that a push which first resolves an earlier pending attempt as confirmed records that copy as the newest receipt before a later step fails, and the rest of the claim holds otherwise.
